hooks.command:
f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/TODO.md"; [ -r "$f" ] || exit 0; list=$("$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/scripts/todo-status" -f "$f") || exit 0; [ -n "$list" ] || exit 0; jq -n --arg l "$list" '{systemMessage: ("Open items in TODO.md:

" + $l), hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: ("Open TODO.md items for this repo (.claude/scripts/todo-status; /todo shows them on demand). Mention them briefly to the user at the start of the session, and call out any marked OVERDUE:

" + $l)}}'
